stat.title: Sites
stat.sqlForIndicator: select count(s.id) as cnt from Site as s left outer join Geography as g on s.geographyId = g.id left outer join State as st on g.stateId = st.id left outer join Lga as l on g.lgaId = l.id

stat.title: Devices
stat.sqlForIndicator: select count(d.id) as cnt from Device as d inner join Site as s on s.id = d.siteId inner join DeviceType as dt on dt.id = d.deviceTypeId inner join DeviceTypeCategory as dc on dc.id = dt.deviceTypeCategoryId left outer join Geography as g on s.geographyId = g.id where dc.hasResults = 1
stat.description: The number of devices which type's category allows results

stat.title: Results
stat.subTitle: Last 30 Days
stat.sqlForIndicator: select ifnull(sum(f.resultCount), 0) as cnt from FactResultsDevice as f inner join Device as d on d.id = f.deviceId inner join Site as s on s.id = d.siteId inner join Partner as p on p.id = s.partnerId left outer join Geography as g on s.geographyId = g.id where f.days = 30
stat.description: The number of results for the last 30 days

stat.title: Contacts
stat.sqlForIndicator: select count(u.id) as cnt from User as u

stat.title: Confirmed cases
stat.sqlForIndicator: SELECT IFNULL(SUM(f.resultCount), 0) AS cnt FROM FactResultsDeviceByCategory1 AS f INNER JOIN Device AS d ON d.id = f.deviceId INNER JOIN Site AS s ON s.id = d.siteId INNER JOIN Partner AS p ON p.id = s.partnerId INNER JOIN Assay a ON f.`assayId`= a.`id` INNER JOIN ResultCategory rc ON f.resultCategory1 = rc.`id` LEFT OUTER JOIN Geography AS g ON s.geographyId = g.id WHERE rc.externalid='Positive' and f.days=9999
stat.sqlForStatUnit: SELECT IFNULL(SUM(f.resultCount), 0) AS cnt FROM FactResultsDeviceByCategory1 AS f INNER JOIN Device AS d ON d.id = f.deviceId INNER JOIN Site AS s ON s.id = d.siteId INNER JOIN Partner AS p ON p.id = s.partnerId INNER JOIN Assay a ON f.`assayId`= a.`id` INNER JOIN ResultCategory rc ON f.resultCategory1 = rc.`id` LEFT OUTER JOIN Geography AS g ON s.geographyId = g.id WHERE rc.externalid='Positive' and f.days=7
stat.description: The number of positive results reported the last 7 days

stat.title: Active cases
stat.sqlForIndicator: SELECT IFNULL(COUNT(f.id), 0) AS cnt FROM Result AS f INNER JOIN Device AS d ON d.id = f.deviceId INNER JOIN Site AS s ON s.id = d.siteId INNER JOIN Partner AS p ON p.id = s.partnerId INNER JOIN Assay a ON f.`assayId`= a.`id` INNER JOIN ResultCategory rc ON f.resultCategory1 = rc.`id` LEFT OUTER JOIN Geography AS g ON s.geographyId = g.id WHERE rc.externalid='Positive' AND NOT EXISTS (SELECT * FROM ResultFollowUp rfu INNER JOIN FollowUp fu ON fu.`id`=rfu.`followUpId` INNER JOIN FollowUpType ft ON fu.`followUpTypeId` =ft.id WHERE ft.externalid='outcome' AND rfu.resultId=f.id)
stat.sqlForStatUnit: SELECT IFNULL(COUNT(f.id), 0) AS cnt FROM Result AS f INNER JOIN Device AS d ON d.id = f.deviceId INNER JOIN Site AS s ON s.id = d.siteId INNER JOIN Partner AS p ON p.id = s.partnerId INNER JOIN Assay a ON f.`assayId`= a.`id` INNER JOIN ResultCategory rc ON f.resultCategory1 = rc.`id` LEFT OUTER JOIN Geography AS g ON s.geographyId = g.id WHERE rc.externalid='Positive' and f.createdOn >= DATE_SUB(NOW(), INTERVAL 7 DAY) AND NOT EXISTS (SELECT * FROM ResultFollowUp rfu INNER JOIN FollowUp fu ON fu.`id`=rfu.`followUpId` INNER JOIN FollowUpType ft ON fu.`followUpTypeId` =ft.id WHERE ft.externalid='outcome' AND rfu.resultId=f.id)
stat.description: The number results reported positive that haven't an outcome

stat.title: Recovered cases
stat.sqlForIndicator: SELECT COUNT(rfu.resultId) as cnt FROM ResultFollowUp AS rfu INNER JOIN FollowUp AS fu ON fu.id = rfu.followUpId INNER JOIN FollowUpType AS ft ON fu.followUpTypeId = ft.id INNER JOIN Result AS r ON rfu.resultId = r.id INNER JOIN Device AS d ON d.id = r.deviceId INNER JOIN Site AS s ON s.id = d.siteId INNER JOIN Partner AS p ON p.id = s.partnerId WHERE ft.externalid = 'outcome' AND fu.externalId='Recovered'
stat.sqlForStatUnit: SELECT COUNT(rfu.resultId) as cnt FROM ResultFollowUp AS rfu INNER JOIN FollowUp AS fu ON fu.id = rfu.followUpId INNER JOIN FollowUpType AS ft ON fu.followUpTypeId = ft.id INNER JOIN Result AS r ON rfu.resultId = r.id INNER JOIN Device AS d ON d.id = r.deviceId INNER JOIN Site AS s ON s.id = d.siteId INNER JOIN Partner AS p ON p.id = s.partnerId WHERE ft.externalid = 'outcome' AND fu.externalId='Recovered' AND rfu.createdOn >= DATE_SUB(NOW(), INTERVAL 7 DAY)

stat.title: Deaths
stat.sqlForIndicator: SELECT COUNT(rfu.resultId) as cnt FROM ResultFollowUp AS rfu INNER JOIN FollowUp AS fu ON fu.id = rfu.followUpId INNER JOIN FollowUpType AS ft ON fu.followUpTypeId = ft.id INNER JOIN Result AS r ON rfu.resultId = r.id INNER JOIN Device AS d ON d.id = r.deviceId INNER JOIN Site AS s ON s.id = d.siteId INNER JOIN Partner AS p ON p.id = s.partnerId WHERE fu.externalId='Died'
stat.sqlForStatUnit: SELECT COUNT(rfu.resultId) as cnt FROM ResultFollowUp AS rfu INNER JOIN FollowUp AS fu ON fu.id = rfu.followUpId INNER JOIN FollowUpType AS ft ON fu.followUpTypeId = ft.id INNER JOIN Result AS r ON rfu.resultId = r.id INNER JOIN Device AS d ON d.id = r.deviceId INNER JOIN Site AS s ON s.id = d.siteId INNER JOIN Partner AS p ON p.id = s.partnerId WHERE fu.externalId='Died' AND rfu.createdOn >= DATE_SUB(NOW(), INTERVAL 7 DAY)
stat.description: The number of cases ended in death
